mode.title: Mode
mode.description: summary = one row per coin per venue with long vs short liquidated in USD and the ratio between them. liquidations = one row per forced closeout. positioning = the OKX long/short account ratio over time, which is the build up a cascade needs.

coins.title: Coins
coins.description: Base coins to track, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL. USDT perpetuals are used on both venues. Maximum 30 per run.

venues.title: Exchanges
venues.description: Which venues to read: okx, gate. OKX carries far more events; Gate is a thin second source.

side.title: Side liquidated
side.description: Return only long liquidations (forced selling into a drop), only short liquidations (a squeeze), or both.

minValueUsd.title: Min liquidation size (USD)
minValueUsd.description: Skip liquidations smaller than this. Raise it to see only the large forced closeouts that actually move price. 0 = every event.

period.title: Period (positioning mode)
period.description: Candle size for the long/short account ratio series.

positioningPoints.title: Points per coin (positioning mode)
positioningPoints.description: How many of the most recent ratio readings to return for each coin.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost. Busy coins can produce thousands of liquidation events per day.
